content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user of the task reporting page","i_want":"to search tasks by their title","so_that":"I can find a specific task in the report without scanning the whole table","business_description":"The Task Reporting page lets the user search the report by task title. The search is applied through the backend report API, which accepts a title search value and returns only the matching tasks. The title search is one of the report's filtering, searching, sorting and metric aggregation capabilities.","business_value":"Users can locate a task by its title directly in the report, which reduces the time spent scanning the full task table.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The reporting page shows tasks and a title search input is visible; tasks titled 'Pay rent' and 'Buy milk' exist","when":"The user enters 'Pay rent' in the search input and submits the search","then":"The backend report API is called with the search text 'Pay rent' and the table shows only the task titled 'Pay rent'"},{"given":"The reporting page shows tasks; no task has a title that contains 'zzz-no-match'","when":"The user enters 'zzz-no-match' in the search input and submits the search","then":"The table shows no rows and the message 'No tasks match the search' is displayed"},{"given":"A search text is entered on the reporting page and the table shows only matching tasks","when":"The user clears the search input and submits the empty search","then":"The backend report API is called without a title search value and the table shows all tasks again"},{"given":"The report API is running and the database holds tasks with titles 'Pay rent' and 'Buy milk'","when":"A client calls the report API with the title search parameter set to 'Pay rent'","then":"The response status is 200 and the response contains only the task whose Title is 'Pay rent'"},{"given":"The reporting page shows tasks and the report API returns an error response for the search request","when":"The user submits a title search","then":"The table does not show the previous results as a successful search result and an error message is displayed"},{"given":"The report API is running and the database holds tasks with titles 'Pay rent' and 'Buy milk' and a status filter is set to Completed","when":"A client calls the report API with the title search parameter set to 'Pay rent' and the status filter set to Completed","then":"The response contains only the tasks that match both the title search and the status filter"}],"edge_cases":["An empty or missing title search value means no title filter is applied and all tasks are returned.","The PRD does not state whether title matching is a substring match or an exact match; the acceptance criteria assume a substring match (open question).","The PRD does not state whether title matching is case-sensitive; this is an open question.","The PRD does not state how a whitespace-only search value is handled; this is an open question.","The PRD does not state the maximum length of the search text; this is an open question.","Title search, status and priority filters, date range, and sort parameters are combined on the same report endpoint and applied together to the same result set (assumed; to be confirmed with the team)."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-report"],"definition_of_done":["The report endpoint accepts an optional title search parameter and applies it to the Title field of each task.","The title search parameter is added to the existing report endpoint and no separate search endpoint is created.","A request with no title search value returns the same result as before this change.","The title search parameter can be combined with the filter and sort parameters on the same endpoint, and a test shows the combined result.","The reporting page search input sends the search text to the report endpoint and displays the returned rows.","When the search returns no rows, the message 'No tasks match the search' is displayed.","When the search request fails, the previous results are not shown as a successful search result and an error message is displayed.","The open questions on matching rules (substring, case, whitespace, maximum length) are answered and recorded in the story before release."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"report-title-search-param","title":"[BE] Add optional title search parameter to the task report endpoint","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add an optional title search parameter to the existing task report endpoint. When a non-empty value is given, return only tasks whose Title matches it. When the parameter is absent or empty, apply no title filter. Use the same endpoint as the report and filter and sort parameters so that all of them can be combined in one request. Do not create a separate search endpoint. Return status 200 for valid requests and use the backend error handling rules for invalid input.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-8007d6b5","R-48e39a9d"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["The existing report endpoint accepts an optional title search parameter.","Only tasks whose Title matches the search value are returned when the parameter is non-empty.","No title filter is applied when the parameter is absent or empty.","The parameter combines with status, priority, date range and sort parameters on the same endpoint.","Invalid input returns an error response using the backend error handling approach.","No separate search endpoint is added."]},{"key_slug":"report-title-search-input","title":"[FE] Add title search input to the task reporting page","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Add a title search input to the Task Reporting page.
